contact_edits.before: The visual interest here is confined to the opening moment when we glimpse the actors, and the dolls, through a scrim. The poster looks far better than the play; it depicts not dolls but marionettes, with broken strings. If there's a joke there, it hasn't landed on stage. Borkman is a play we hardly ever see, and one that Soulpepper might have cast superbly from its own ranks; there are at least two potential, though widely different, Borkmen among the company's regulars. To do it like this is an opportunity criminally wasted. - Until April 21. Call 416-866-8666.
